canonical:
glassbox-canonical 1
version 2
id "itajara-layer"
title "One layer slot of one Itajara loop"
clock -
initial "free"
notes 60
  note "The life of one layer slot in one loop of the Itajara daemon"
  note "(music/itajara/daemon/src/engine/layer.rs), written down. itajara-loop"
  note "next door is the loop's phase machine; this is what one of its slots is"
  note "doing meanwhile. A loop has N slots (`--max-layers`), each running this"
  note "machine; the loop's `n_layers` counts how many are in a counted state."
  note ""
  note "WHY IT EXISTS. On 2026-09-07 a take into a cleared slot played only where"
  note "the previous occupant's window had been: the window is a per-slot"
  note "setting, and nothing said which settings belong to the audio and go with"
  note "it, and which describe the slot and stay. This machine says: EVERYTHING"
  note "a layer carries — length, tail, born, period and phase, gain, on, window"
  note "— belongs to the audio, and `set-shape` on the way out of Writing is the"
  note "one moment the slot is made clean. Undo keeps the audio for redo, so it"
  note "keeps the settings; a new take does not. The Rust fix was one line in"
  note "`Layer::set_shape`; this is the line as a table, so the next setting"
  note "added to a layer is asked the same question."
  note ""
  note "WHICH QUALIFIERS BECAME STATES. Free, Writing, Summing, Sounding, Off and"
  note "Undone. Sounding and Off are two states rather than one with a fact"
  note "because `on` and `off` swap them and the loop's alternate rule reads the"
  note "difference for every layer at once. Writing and Summing are two because"
  note "they enter differently — a take zeroes the slot, a summed pass does not"
  note "(taxonomy §2C: sound-on-sound is passes summing into one layer) — and"
  note "leave differently: a take is shaped, a pass only redraws. Undone is a"
  note "state because it is neither counted nor gone: `redo` brings it back and"
  note "`start` drops it, and no fact could carry both."
  note ""
  note "WHICH QUALIFIERS STAYED FACTS. `top` and `next-to-redo` are the loop's"
  note "stack discipline — undo reaches only the highest counted slot, redo only"
  note "the lowest undone one — and the loop knows them, not the slot. `was-on`"
  note "is the history-state workaround the README names: an undone layer comes"
  note "back as it was, and the host remembers which."
  note ""
  note "WHAT THE DAEMON'S REPLAY CHANGED (2026-09-07, the first day). Two rules"
  note "were written from the loop artifact's side and the engine had reasons:"
  note "a lost device DROPS a partial overdub as it drops a partial first take —"
  note "a layer with a gap in it is worse than no layer (`drop_takes`) — so"
  note "`writing × lost` goes to Free whatever the take was, and the `first-take`"
  note "fact that told them apart is gone; and a layer a pass is summing into"
  note "still takes `on`, `off` and `window`, because the write head follows the"
  note "play head through whatever the layer is doing, so those three stay"
  note "rather than refuse. The loop artifact's `overdubbing-open × lost →"
  note "playing [close-layer]` still names the wrong command for that exit; the"
  note "loop's replay cannot see it and it is left as a known lie."
  note ""
  note "WHAT THE MACHINE DOES NOT KNOW. Arguments and counting. `lw` stores the"
  note "window and the machine only says when a window is LEGAL (a counted"
  note "layer, not one being written) and when it is DROPPED (`set-shape`)."
  note "`n_layers` and `redo_to` are the loop's, moved by the loop machine's"
  note "`close-layer` and by undo and redo there; this slot never counts itself."
  note "The alternate rule (`alt`, taxonomy §6) is also the loop's: it decides"
  note "which slots receive `off` when one is `commit`ted, and this machine just"
  note "obeys."
  note ""
  note "REFUSAL TAGS. `nothing-here` (the slot holds nothing), `still-writing`"
  note "(the daemon's `still_recording` seen from the slot), `occupied` (a take"
  note "may not start over a counted layer — a summed pass is `sum`, not"
  note "`start`), `not-counted` (an undone layer takes no setting), `not-top`"
  note "and `not-next` (the stack), `not-undone` (redo on a layer that is"
  note "there)."
states 6
  state "free" "Free" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
  state "off" "Off" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
  state "sounding" "Sounding" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
  state "summing" "Summing a pass" false (entry 1 "start-write") (exit 1 "redraw")
  state "undone" "Undone, kept" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
  state "writing" "Writing a take" false (entry 2 "zero-slot" "start-write") (exit 1 "set-shape")
events 10
  event "clear" "the loop is cleared (c)" user
  event "commit" "the write closed" runtime
  event "lost" "the audio device was lost" runtime
  event "off" "turn it off (ly k 0)" user
  event "on" "turn it on (ly k 1)" user
  event "redo" "redo reaches this layer (y)" user
  event "start" "a take starts here (r, x, t, cp, dp)" user
  event "sum" "a pass sums into this layer (r on an alt loop)" user
  event "undo" "undo reaches this layer (u)" user
  event "window" "set or clear its window (lw)" user
config 0
facts 3
  fact "next-to-redo" "This is the lowest undone layer"
  fact "top" "This is the highest counted layer"
  fact "was-on" "It was on when it was undone"
refusals 7
  refusal "not-counted" "the layer is undone; redo it first"
  refusal "not-next" "redo reaches only the oldest undone layer"
  refusal "not-top" "undo reaches only the newest layer"
  refusal "not-undone" "the layer is there; nothing to redo"
  refusal "nothing-here" "the slot holds nothing"
  refusal "occupied" "a take cannot start over a layer; sum into it, or undo it"
  refusal "still-writing" "the layer is being written; finish that first"
commands 4
  command "redraw" "Rebuild the envelope; length, tail, born and window are untouched"
  command "set-shape" "Declare the layer: length, tail, born; period 1, phase 0, gain 1, on, NO window"
  command "start-write" "Point the write head at this slot"
  command "zero-slot" "Zero the slot's audio: whatever was kept here is dropped"
rules 60
  rule "free" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "free" "commit" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "free" "lost" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "free" "off" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nothing-here")))
  rule "free" "on" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nothing-here")))
  rule "free" "redo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nothing-here")))
  rule "free" "start" (cases 1 (case - (move "writing")))
  rule "free" "sum" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nothing-here")))
  rule "free" "undo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nothing-here")))
  rule "free" "window" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nothing-here")))
  rule "off" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "free")))
  rule "off" "commit" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "lost" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "off" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "on" (cases 1 (case - (move "sounding")))
  rule "off" "redo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-undone")))
  rule "off" "start" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "occupied")))
  rule "off" "sum" (cases 1 (case - (move "summing")))
  rule "off" "undo" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "top")) (move "undone")) (case - (refuse "not-top")))
  rule "off" "window" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "sounding" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "free")))
  rule "sounding" "commit" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "sounding" "lost" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "sounding" "off" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "sounding" "on" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "sounding" "redo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-undone")))
  rule "sounding" "start" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "occupied")))
  rule "sounding" "sum" (cases 1 (case - (move "summing")))
  rule "sounding" "undo" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "top")) (move "undone")) (case - (refuse "not-top")))
  rule "sounding" "window" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "summing" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "free")))
  rule "summing" "commit" (cases 1 (case - (move "sounding")))
  rule "summing" "lost" (cases 1 (case - (move "sounding")))
  rule "summing" "off" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "summing" "on" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "summing" "redo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "summing" "start" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "summing" "sum" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "summing" "undo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "summing" "window" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "undone" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "free")))
  rule "undone" "commit" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "undone" "lost" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "undone" "off" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-counted")))
  rule "undone" "on" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-counted")))
  rule "undone" "redo" (cases 3 (case (and 2 (holds (fact "next-to-redo")) (holds (fact "was-on"))) (move "sounding")) (case (holds (fact "next-to-redo")) (move "off")) (case - (refuse "not-next")))
  rule "undone" "start" (cases 1 (case - (move "writing")))
  rule "undone" "sum" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-counted")))
  rule "undone" "undo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-counted")))
  rule "undone" "window" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-counted")))
  rule "writing" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "free")))
  rule "writing" "commit" (cases 1 (case - (move "sounding")))
  rule "writing" "lost" (cases 1 (case - (move "free")))
  rule "writing" "off" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "writing" "on" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "writing" "redo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "writing" "start" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "writing" "sum" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "writing" "undo" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
  rule "writing" "window" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "still-writing")))
deadlines 0
